hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path);if(f)process.stdout.write(f)}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) dir=$(dirname "$f"); golangci-lint run --fix "$dir/..." 2>&1 | tail -40 ;; esac; } || true
